subject: Launch readiness: action grid & legal sequencing for NovaMedics MSA/DPA
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novamedics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Launch readiness: action grid & legal sequencing for NovaMedics MSA/DPA

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Attached is an initial "action grid" and a compact evaluation plan that translate the MAP we discussed into sequencing and gating items for legal/procurement. High level asks from our side:

- Can you confirm the target sign date for the order form?
- Who will own the PO and billing contact?
- Are there any procurement windows (e.g., board approvals) that could shift the schedule?

Key gating items I put on the grid: signed MSA (legal redline cycle), signed DPA (privacy), vendor security questionnaire & SOC 2 evidence, PO issuance, and order form signature. Suggest we run DPA and security review in parallel with the legal redline to avoid serial delays.

I've attached: NovaMedics_EvalPlan.xlsx and Action_Grid_v1.xlsx. I sketched a proposed milestone cadence (legal review week of 11/9, procurement/PO by 11/18) but please push back with your constraints.

Next steps: if you confirm PO ownership and a target sign date, I'll convert the grid into a mutual action plan with owners and dates. Vanessa will be the procurement point on our side.

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
Attachment: NovaMedics_EvalPlan.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: Action_Grid_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novamedics.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@novamedics.com>, procurement@novamedics.com
Date: 2026-11-03T11:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Launch readiness: action grid & legal sequencing for NovaMedics MSA/DPA

Michael —

Appreciate this. Quick answers:
- Target sign date: our internal goal is EOD 2026-11-18, but legal review could push and we have a procurement cutoff on 11/19 for this quarter.
- PO & billing contact: Procurement will own the PO (procurement@novamedics.com). Billing contact is Lydia Chen (cc not on this thread yet).
- Procurement windows: as noted, quarter-end cutoffs are real — if we miss 11/19 the PO moves to next quarter.

I've attached our initial MSA comments (NM_MSA_comments.docx) and looped in Oliver from Legal to coordinate redlines. On terms: procurement prefers net30; is that acceptable?

Samira Khan
Director, Digital Strategy — NovaMedics
samira.khan@novamedics.com
Attachment: NM_MSA_comments.docx (docx)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novamedics.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@novamedics.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Launch readiness: action grid & legal sequencing for NovaMedics MSA/DPA

Samira / Oliver —

Thanks for the clarity. Net30 is standard for us — Vanessa, can you confirm finance is okay with net30 for this deal?

Sequencing proposal (high level):
1) Legal: consolidate redlines (Oliver's team) -> exchange counter-redline by 11/10.
2) Security: procure SOC 2 report + complete vendor questionnaire in parallel (target 11/12).
3) DPA: prepare Redwood template (we'll send) and run in parallel with legal redlines.
4) Procurement: PO issued by 11/18 -> order form sign immediately after PO issuance.

If we can keep steps 1–3 moving concurrently we should be able to close inside your November window. I'm pushing the action grid into the HubSpot deal and linking the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-novamedics-eval (see tab "MAP - action grid").

I'll convert the grid to a mutually owned MAP with owners and dates once Vanessa confirms finance.

—Michael
Attachment: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@novamedics.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@novamedics.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Launch readiness: action grid & legal sequencing for NovaMedics MSA/DPA

Team —

I reviewed NM_MSA_comments.docx and sketched a short redline packet (attached MSA_v2_redlines.pdf) with the non-negotiable items flagged and a couple of compromise language options where appropriate. A few notes:

- We need the SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and the vendor questionnaire completed before we can accept broad data access clauses.
- DPA should be consistent with our processing addendum; I'll prepare a template but will need their feedback on data residency / subprocessors.
- If they insist on subcontractor secrecy around certain controls, we'll need named-subprocessor list + an SLA on notification.

I'll be ready to run an internal exception if legal time moves beyond your 11/16 gate, but we'd prefer not to.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: MSA_v2_redlines.pdf (pdf)

From: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@novamedics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@novamedics.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T10:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Launch readiness: action grid & legal sequencing for NovaMedics MSA/DPA

Karthik —

Thanks for the packet. A few clarifying Qs from Legal:
- Data residency: NovaMedics requires EU-sourced patient-derived models to remain in EU region; can you confirm regional tenanting and encryption-at-rest controls?
- Subprocessors: please provide your current subprocessor list and an explanation of notification cadence for additions.
- Can Redwood accept a narrow carveout for emergency data access strictly for security incidents with a defined 24-hr notification window?

I've attached a short list of our legal questions for your team's review (NM_Legal_Questions.pdf). We can run a synchronous call if that speeds things up.

Oliver Reed
Counsel, NovaMedics
oliver.reed@novamedics.com
Attachment: NM_Legal_Questions.pdf (pdf)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novamedics.com>, Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@novamedics.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Finalizing MAP: revised action grid + milestone commitments (legal -> PO -> sign)

Team —

I've attached Action_Grid_v2.xlsx which includes owners, dates, and a lightweight acceptance checklist to drive the MAP. Summary of agreed sequencing and commitments:

- Legal redline exchange complete by 11/16 (status: complete; see MSA_v2_redlines.pdf).
- Security evidence (SOC 2 + questionnaire) complete by 11/12 (status: received).
- Procurement: target PO issuance 11/18 (Procurement contact confirmed).
- Order form signature: immediate upon PO; target sign date 11/18.
- Canary deployment & acceptance window: week of 11/29 with final acceptance 12/03.

Open asks / next owners:
- Vanessa: please confirm finance sign-off for net30 terms and queue order form for countersignature after PO.
- Karthik: please prepare DPA template and respond to Oliver's subprocessors/residency Qs (he's sent NM_Legal_Questions.pdf).
- Samira / Procurement: please send PO by COB 11/18 to avoid slipping to next quarter.

If everyone is aligned I'll push the MAP into HubSpot and send a DocuSign envelope for a narrow SOW + order form once the PO arrives. Attaching a stub SOW to accelerate the signature path.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this one quickly.

Michael Grant
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
